ruleDefinitions.name: Mesh Agent Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a Mesh Agent service installation. Mesh Agent is used to remotely manage computers Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*MeshAgent\\\.exe.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*Mesh\\ Agent.*")))
